notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
Thanks to Steam user x-calibar for detailed bug reports!

[list]
[*] Fixed a typo in Green Hair dialogue.
[*] Fixed a broken dialogue path in the Lonely Isles Old Man dialogue.
[*] Removed pathing behind the Spectre in the South Memory tent to prevent players from getting stuck when the lamp appears.
[/list]
